name: ShadowFi
fix_description: Add access control to the burn function: either restrict to onlyOwner, or change to only allow burning the callers own tokens by replacing account parameter with msg.sender.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct reserve-manipulation exploit: buy the token, call an exposed burn on the pair’s balance, sync the pair, then sell back at the distorted price. It uses only a few external calls, no flash loan or complex protocol logic, and the bug pattern is fairly obvious once the public burn function is noticed.
